# helper output; ExpandHint short-circuits render as empty strings.

MoreItems(1,"line","lines")
  -> "… 1 more line"
MoreItems(2,"line","lines")
  -> "… 2 more lines"
MoreItems(240,"line","lines")
  -> "… 240 more lines"
MoreItems(0,"file","files")
  -> "… 0 more files"

EarlierItems(1,"line","lines")
  -> "… 1 earlier line"
EarlierItems(3,"file","files")
  -> "… 3 earlier files"
EarlierItems(240,"line","lines")
  -> "… 240 earlier lines"

ExpandHint(false,true,"enter")
  -> "[enter: Expand]"
ExpandHint(true,true,"enter")     (expanded -> empty)
  -> ""
ExpandHint(false,false,"enter")   (nothing hidden -> empty)
  -> ""
ExpandHint(false,true," ")        (whitespace key -> empty)
  -> ""
ExpandHint(false,true,"ctrl+o")    (rebind flows through)
  -> "[ctrl+o: Expand]"

HintLine(MoreItems(4,"line","lines"), ExpandHint(false,true,"enter"))
  -> "… 4 more lines [enter: Expand]"
HintLine(EarlierItems(3,"line","lines"), ExpandHint(false,true,"enter"))
  -> "… 3 earlier lines [enter: Expand]"
HintLine(MoreItems(4,"line","lines"), "")           (no hint -> more only)
  -> "… 4 more lines"
HintLine("", "")                                     (both empty)
  -> ""

CaptureTruncatedHint()
  -> "… capture truncated at write"
